title: Inter Women beat Fiorentina 2–0 in their Serie A opener
description: Three Nerazzurri travel to Bursa for Italy's match in Turkey tonight, with Nicolò Barella among the ten players Roberto Mancini left at Coverciano.
mast_alt: Nerazzurri Daily Edition No. 27, Monday, September 28, 2026 — Inter Women beat Fiorentina 2–0 in their Serie A opener

blocks.html: Inter Women won their Serie A opener 2–0 at the Arena Civica on Sunday. The midfielder Lina Magull scored in the 72nd minute, and the forward Brittany Raphino headed in a free kick in the 91st minute. Italy play Turkey in Bursa at 2:45 PM ET tonight, 20:45 CEST, with three Inter players in the squad and the midfielder Nicolò Barella left at Coverciano.

blocks.h3: Inter Women beat Fiorentina 2–0 on their opening day
paras: Inter Women won 2–0 at the Arena Civica Gianni Brera in Milan on Sunday, on matchday 1 of Serie A Women. It was their first league win of the season.

Lina Magull, the Inter Women midfielder, scored from close range in the 72nd minute. Brittany Raphino, the Inter Women forward, headed in a free kick in the 91st minute. Inter finished with ten after a second yellow card in stoppage time.
David Sassarini, the Inter Women head coach, told Inter TV: “Abbiamo fatto una gran partita” — we played a great match.

blocks.h3: Three Nerazzurri travel to Bursa, Barella stays behind
paras: Italy play Turkey in Bursa at 2:45 PM ET tonight, which is 20:45 CEST. The match is at the Atatürk Spor Kompleksi. Alessandro Bastoni and Federico Dimarco, the Inter defenders, and Francesco Pio Esposito, the Inter forward, are in the traveling squad.
Nicolò Barella, the Inter midfielder, is one of ten players Roberto Mancini, the Italy head coach, left training at Coverciano instead of making the trip. Italy lost 0–2 to Belgium in Rome on Friday.

blocks.h3: Bisseck and Stankovic both lose on Sunday night
paras: Yann Bisseck, the Inter center back, played all 90 minutes as Germany lost 0–1 to Greece. Aleksandar Stankovic, the Inter midfielder, played 59 minutes as Serbia lost at home to the Netherlands.
Greece lead the group; the Netherlands have four points, Germany one, Serbia none.

blocks.h3: Gazzetta dello Sport: Thuram starts against Parma
paras: Gazzetta dello Sport, Italy’s biggest sports daily, expects Marcus Thuram, the Inter forward, to start against Parma on October 10, back alongside Lautaro Martínez, the Inter captain and forward.
Zinedine Zidane, the France head coach, has not called Thuram up since taking the job. He spent the break training at Appiano Gentile, Inter’s training ground, while his teammates were away.
blocks.kicker: GAZZETTA DELLO SPORT VIA FCINTERNEWS · SEP 27

paras: TEAMtalk, an English soccer site, says Chelsea have made Alessandro Bastoni their first choice for the left of a back three. Xabi Alonso, the Chelsea head coach, has pushed for him, the site says, and Inter’s asking price is about £70 million.
It reports no talks between the clubs, and says Bastoni would be open to the Premier League. Inter have announced nothing.
